propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field is declared in schema but never read anywhere in src/rebar codebase
Structural metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) evaluate regardless of enabled flag setting
The inert-config gate cannot detect this field because .enabled is read on other configs (ui.enabled, LangfuseConfig), causing it to pass global attribute name matching despite being unused locally

Operator decision recorded 2026-08-05: REMOVE the field rather than wire it, acknowledging this differs from sibling dce2 because deletion removes the only advertised off-switch for code-health subsystem
Removal requires deletion of field, coercion row, config-surface entries, and addition of warn-class tombstones for both cfg and env input channels to prevent silent drops
